claim: The public HERCULES protocol describes ToleDYNAMIC, an 80-participant immunological substudy spanning HERCULES and PERSEUS (about 40 participants from each) with samples at baseline, month 3, and month 12; it repeatedly specifies tolebrutinib-treated participants and sampling after initiation of tolebrutinib, so the public design supports an active-treatment-only interpretation unless sponsor metadata establish otherwise. Planned measurements include B-cell and CD14-monocyte RNA sequencing in a subset, detailed lymphocyte/monocyte phenotyping, CD64 and other monocyte-state markers, cytokines, myelin phagocytosis, reactive oxygen species, and Seahorse metabolic assays linked to parent-trial clinical and MRI data.
future_grounding_route: Ask Sanofi/Vivli whether ToleDYNAMIC data, separate SAP, data dictionary, parent-trial linkage, arm assignment, raw RNA counts, flow cytometry, and functional-assay outputs are available. Treat the public protocol as active-treatment-only Branch B by default. Permit randomized treatment-by-time analysis only if documentary design metadata establish placebo sampling and outcome-blind selection contrary to that reading; otherwise restrict interpretation to paired pharmacodynamic trajectories and cross-trial sufficiency checks.

project_finding_reference.finding_id: The next rational computation requires longitudinal progression-treatment molecular data

project_use: Highest-priority molecular controlled-data acquisition target because it could measure pre-existing APC/HLA-II, CD64, lysosomal, MIF, metabolic, and resolution modules longitudinally under a progression-treatment intervention. The public active-treatment-only wording means it cannot estimate a randomized drug effect by default; its strongest use is testing whether the same peripheral pharmacodynamic trajectory occurs in clinically divergent parent trials. Existence in a protocol does not establish completion, access, assay quality, or a mechanism.
relationship_note: The planned substudy overlaps unusually well with project-grounded module questions, but no ToleDYNAMIC result is integrated and no project route is upgraded until controlled data are obtained and rerun under a frozen plan.
